result.rationale: The diff adds totalPages as Math.floor(user_count/limit)+1 in admin-group.js.es6. With user_count exactly divisible by limit (e.g., 50/50), this yields 2 pages when only 1 exists, so showingLast (propertyEqual currentPage/totalPages) is false on the real last page and 'next' fetches an empty page (offset capped at user_count). Mechanism fully verifiable from the diff.
